correctness.rationale: For every m>=2, 1<=k<=m the block-grounded L_FF has contrast eigenvalues m+1 and m, two-mode trace 2m+1 and positive determinant D(a)=mk+a(a-k+1). Formula J(a)=(m-a-1)/(m+1)^2+(m+1-k+a-1)/m^2+[(2m+1)^2-2D]/D^2 remains valid at u=0 by cancellation. Since D(a)<=mk and the contrast contribution increases strictly with a, J(mixed)>J(a=0). Direct rational algebra gives J(k)-J(0)=P_m(k)/[k^2m^2(m+1)^2], with P=(2m+1)k^3+2m(m+1)k-(2m+1)^3. Its derivative is positive; dominant-balance root has leading 4^(1/3)m^(2/3) and next term -m^(1/3)/(3*4^(1/3)). This proves pure optimal families, strict mixed exclusion, tie case and stated asymptotics; no finite test substitutes for proof.
